title: How many voters each channel can reach
description: The electorate split into three mutually exclusive reach segments, modelled from published rates.
notes: MODELLED. Published rates multiplied by the register: not a measurement.

Internet use is the CA/KNBS 2023/24 county rate (46.9%); phone ownership is the 2019 census rate (61.8%), because the 2023/24 county phone row is not yet in hand. Mixing years makes the SMS-only layer an estimate.
Rates are for all persons aged 3 and over, so applying them to adult voters understates phone ownership among voters.

values.label: Reachable by smartphone or data
values.note: 46.9% internet use, CA/KNBS 2023/24, up from 39.2% in 2019
